description:
Run a QueryPlan (see get_catalog.plan_schema). Returns status (ok | clarify |
    unsupported | error), a one-paragraph answer, columns, rows (max 100), the SQL that ran,
    caveats and how names were resolved to codes.

plan.description: A QueryPlan object in business terms, following get_catalog's plan_schema, e.g. {"intent": "aggregate", "metric": "obligations", "group_by": ["agency"], "fiscal_years": [2025], "award_category": "contract"} (award_category is a field of its own, not a filter).
plan.title: Plan

name: run_plan
title: Run a spending query
